heading: Threat model
body: `bare-structured-clone` is one of the addons Bare compiles into its binary, so every Bare process has it, sealed or not, and it inherits [Bare's threat model](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md). The module's own [threat model](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-structured-clone/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md), added in v2.0.1, says where it sits in that one. It turns bytes into typed values and reaches the backing stores of `ArrayBuffer` and `SharedArrayBuffer`, and thread messaging and transfer lists run on it, so a malformed input is a memory-safety concern rather than a wrong answer.
